content: {"rule": "K-S2", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D4 vs C2 (Luke 2:48-49): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase \"thy father\" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to \"my Father's business.\"", "why": "The judge bases the underdetermination on the verse's internal qualification, not merely on a single verse failing to state a link or its contrary."}
